component.name: Spaced Linux Welcome
component.summary: Install verified applications on a new Spaced Linux system

description.p: Spaced Linux Welcome opens on the first installed-system login, launches the preinstalled SpacedBazaar, and installs suggested Flatpaks from Flathub and the signed Spaced GitHub application repository.
Adds a Compiz desktop-effects quick start and clear first-snapshot and system-customization safety guidance.
Uses the renamed Cards With Cats application name and Flatpak ID.

Installs first-party applications by ID from the signed Spaced GitHub repository, adds a task-oriented Help & Apps page with direct SpacedBazaar links, adds version and homepage details, and fixes the native application icon.
